newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices climb, turnover slips.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices climb, turnover slips.

text.p: The average prices of most Bucharest bourse listings drifted higher on Wednesday as supply stayed thinner than demand.
Fourteen stocks gained on their average prices, nine fell and three remained flat. Most stocks also closed higher thanks to late-trading deals, brokers said.

Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, computed by market capitalisation and average prices, climbed by three and 2.99 percent respectively from Tuesday. The BIG first-tier index rose by 27.63 percent to 3,896.39 points.
Higher capitalisation after two more stocks joined the first tier triggered the rise in the index for this section.
"Demand outstripped supply as sellers are waiting for prices to climb some more," said a trader. "I believe this is going to be the trend on Thursday too."
Wednesday's volume stayed close to a previous 2.8 million shares and turnover fell to 8.7 billion lei from 8.8 billion.
The first tier took 83 percent of turnover. Four of six high-caps had stronger average prices and three closed higher.
Pharmaceuticals companies Antibiotice and Terapia put on 250 and 150 lei respectively to end at 4,850 and 6,250. Oltchim also closed higher, gaining 150 lei to 2,550.
Azomures fertiliser maker, which had the highest turnover level on Wednesday at 2.7 billion lei, closed 50 lei weaker at 3,050 in weaker supply.

Brokers said Arctic refrigerator maker, which joined the bourse on Wednesday, had high volumes for its first day. Sofert, the remaining high-cap, which entered the market on Tuesday but had no trade, closed flat at 75,000.

The second tier was dominated by Policolor dye maker, which took 74 percent of a turnover level of 1.6 billion lei in this section. It closed 200 lei firmer at 5,350. Seven second-tier stocks had no trade and five were suspended.
